title: Codify CEO Mandate 78: never reinvent the wheel, reuse Apache-2.0 work first
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: Susi core and Susi Commercial Apps never reinvent the wheel; Apache-2.0 projects must be used, to reduce bloat and keep the ecosystem blazing fast; a continuation of Mandate 75's Raw Source (main) -> Distill (release) pipeline. Author docs/ceo-mandate-78.md (look before you build, reuse by harvest under Mandate 75, delete what reuse replaces, smaller and faster never the opposite, record the decision), register Mandate 78 in .agents/identity.json, make it discoverable from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and README.md, add the optional `reuse` object to the task schema, add an advisory distill-lint count of landed tasks without a reuse decision (not a finding), and guard it in tests.

reuse.searched: Both repositories: the harvest tooling (local-harvest raw-features, route, pickup, audit) and distill lint already exist; this task adds a rule and one advisory count to the existing lint rather than a new tool.

limitations: The lint count is advice: it is not a finding and never fails --strict.
Nothing verifies that an agent actually searched before building, that a build reason is true, that superseded code was deleted, or that the tree is free of reinvented wheels.
